scope: 175 authoritative tables; excluded: 117 dated duplicates, 3 test-mode shadow tables, 8 derived tables

tables.name: customer_quote_status
tables.purpose: Customer quote status lookup (In Progress / Waiting for Approval / Approved / Cancelled).

tables.name: parts_group
tables.purpose: Part group lookup (with a `is_winner` flag for TJX/Winners reporting).

tables.name: po_quote_request_status
tables.purpose: RFQ status lookup (Draft / Waiting for Quote / Quote Received / Complete / Cancelled).

tables.name: po_quote_submitted_status
tables.purpose: Supplier quote status lookup (Submitted / Approved / Cancelled).

tables.name: po_status
tables.purpose: Purchase order status lookup (11 values, with display sort order).

tables.name: settings
notes: Key/value table with no primary key; `FieldName` is unique in practice.

tables.name: wo_categories
tables.purpose: Work-order category lookup: PM, FOP, ESA, Disposal/Waste, Checkpoint, LP, Emergency Lighting.

tables.name: wo_servtype
tables.purpose: Service type lookup: Interior, Exterior, Maintenance, Request for Proposal.

tables.name: wo_status
tables.purpose: Work-order status lookup (12 values; see DOMAIN-MODEL).

tables.name: customer
tables.purpose: Billing customer master, keyed by Sage `tcustomr.lId` (near-duplicate of `sites`).

columns.name: id
columns.notes: must equal Sage tcustomr.lId

notes: Same id space as `sites` (Sage `tcustomr.lId`); 3,758 of 4,844 site ids also exist here. Not a parent of `sites`.

tables.name: parts
tables.purpose: Parts/item master: number, cost, sell price, stock counters, Sage link, profit formulas.

columns.name: number
columns.notes: joined to Sage tinvent.sPartCode; unique

columns.name: current_quantity
columns.notes: authoritative counter (do not derive from the ledger)

columns.name: sold_quantity
columns.notes: incremented on sale; paired with current_quantity

notes: `current_quantity` is counter-maintained, not derived from `parts_salepurchase_log`.
`subignore` hides the part from the subcontractor portal.
`install_profit_formula` / `recycle_profit_formula` are free-text formulas consumed by the TJX install-cost calculator.

tables.name: shared_parts_list
tables.purpose: Mapping of part code → main part code (shared/TJX parts).

tables.name: sites
tables.purpose: Service site master. `id` **is** the Sage `tcustomr.lId`; `custid` is the Sage parent customer id.

columns.name: id
columns.notes: must equal Sage tcustomr.lId

notes: `id` IS the Sage `tcustomr.lId` and `custid` is the Sage `tcustshp.lCustId`; never renumber.

tables.name: subcontractor
tables.purpose: Subcontractor master (address, e-mail contacts, labour rates interior/exterior/other).
notes: `interior` / `exterior` / `other` are labour rate codes used on purchase invoices.

tables.name: suppliers
tables.purpose: Supplier master, linked to Sage vendor by `sage_vendor_id`; `bypass_po_approval` flag.

columns.name: sage_vendor_id
columns.notes: Sage tvendor.lId

notes: `sage_vendor_id` links to Sage `tvendor.lId`; `bypass_po_approval` disables the approval gate.

tables.name: tjx_room
tables.purpose: Room master (name, sort order) used by TJX quotes.

tables.name: users
tables.purpose: Portal user master (role in `access`, md5 password, subcontractor link, mailing credentials).

columns.name: password
columns.notes: unsalted md5 hex (32 chars)

columns.name: access
columns.notes: role ladder: 1 sub, 2 supplier, 3 tech, 4 office, 6 admin, 9 super

notes: `access` is a ladder (0/1/2/3/4/6/9), not a boolean. `subid` links a portal login to `subcontractor.id`.
`password` is unsalted MD5 — must not be carried forward as-is.

tables.name: parts_inventory
tables.purpose: Per-shipment inventory receipt (cost, sell, markup, qty).

tables.name: parts_inventory_adjustment
tables.purpose: Manual stock adjustments (field counts, subcontractor/site attribution).

tables.name: parts_price_lock
tables.purpose: Single-row global lock on the price editor (id=1).

tables.name: parts_salepurchase_log
tables.purpose: Stock movement ledger: Sale / Purchase / Adjustment, with invoice and qty.

columns.name: transaction_type
columns.notes: observed values: 'Sale', 'Purchase', 'Adjustment'

notes: `woid_poid`, `invoice_number` and `invoice_id` all carry the same document id (the legacy writer duplicates it into three columns).

tables.name: parts_supplier_rates
tables.purpose: Supplier rate card per part (cost, sell, install, recycle, markup, model numbers, warranty).

tables.name: prf
tables.purpose: Purchase requisition form header (internal request before PO).

tables.name: wo_next_pid
tables.purpose: Next work-order number counters (id=1 main series, id=2 maintenance series).

tables.name: workorder
tables.purpose: Master work order (all types: subcontractor, local, project, TJX, PMA). `id` is assigned by the app, not AUTO_INCREMENT.

columns.name: id
columns.notes: app-assigned (wo_next_pid), not AUTO_INCREMENT

columns.name: status
columns.notes: see STATUS-VOCABULARY.md (12 values)

columns.name: tech
columns.notes: users.id where access = 3

columns.name: customer
columns.notes: holds a SITE id in practice (28,587 rows match sites.id, 18,106 have no customer.id match)

columns.name: batched
columns.notes: date the work order was exported to Sage

columns.name: sgsales_done
columns.notes: set to 1 only after the Sage sales invoice is posted; also an edit lock

columns.name: stock_updated
columns.notes: set to 1 after the inventory movement; also an edit lock

columns.name: only_portal_stock_updated
columns.notes: stock moved in the portal only, not in Sage; also an edit lock

notes: `id` is assigned by the application from `wo_next_pid`, not AUTO_INCREMENT; it must not collide with Sage tcustr.sSource or tProject.sName.
One table holds subcontractor, local, project, TJX and PMA work orders; the flavour is expressed by flags (`local`, `is_project_wo`, `is_tjx_quote`, `is_pma_order`).
Rows with ids 99999999 / 44444444 / 9999999 / 9999998 / 0 are cancelled placeholder records.

tables.name: inv_hours
notes: Invoice snapshot of labour. `entered_rate` preserves the raw text.

tables.name: inv_parts
tables.purpose: Invoice snapshot: parts. Deleted and re-created by `calc_submit.php` on every recalculation.
notes: Invoice snapshot, not a live view: `calc_submit.php` deletes and re-inserts these rows on every recalculation.
`entered_price` preserves the operator's raw text; `price` is the applied decimal.

tables.name: inv_project
notes: Maps a work order to the Sage project it is posted under.

tables.name: inv_soparts
notes: Invoice snapshot of special-order parts.

tables.name: inv_tax
tables.purpose: Invoice snapshot: tax/subtotal/total, posted from the calculator form (not recomputed server-side).

columns.name: calc_type
columns.notes: enum('sub','sub_project','local','local_project','')

columns.name: total_amount
columns.notes: varchar; POSTed by the calculator, may be blank on legacy rows

notes: `tax_amount` / `subtotal_amount` / `total_amount` are varchar and are stored exactly as POSTed by the calculator; the server never recomputes them.
24,452 legacy rows have blank totals and NULL `calc_type` (pre-columns era) — do not treat blank as zero.

tables.name: localwo_hours
tables.purpose: Labour entered by local technicians (time in/out, num techs).

tables.name: localwo_sigs
tables.purpose: Technician/customer signatures captured for a local work order.

tables.name: localwo_techs
tables.purpose: Technicians assigned to a local work order.

tables.name: wo_ajax_submit
tables.purpose: Draft payloads saved by the work-order AJAX form.

tables.name: wo_hours
tables.purpose: Labour lines on a work order. `rate` holds a rate *code* (1/2/3); `hourly_rate` is the resolved money rate.

columns.name: rate
columns.notes: rate CODE 1/2/3, not money

columns.name: hourly_rate
columns.notes: resolved money rate; wins over the code when > 0

notes: `rate` is a rate *code* (1/2/3), not money; `hourly_rate` carries the resolved amount and wins when > 0.

tables.name: wo_images_cropped
tables.purpose: Cropped images attached to work orders.

tables.name: wo_invoiceno
tables.purpose: Work order → Sage invoice number mapping.

tables.name: wo_notes
tables.purpose: Note and status-transition history per work order (prev/next status, public flag).
notes: Carries status transitions (`previous_status_id` → `status_id`) and an `is_public` flag.

tables.name: wo_parts
tables.purpose: Parts lines on a work order (the working estimate that gets copied to `inv_parts`).
notes: `partno` may hold the literal placeholder `---` (110 rows) meaning "no part chosen".

tables.name: wo_report
tables.purpose: Service/technician report text, one row per work order; also posted to Sage as a zero-value labour line.

tables.name: wo_revisions
tables.purpose: Full revision snapshot of a work order and all its child rows (serialised in `data_*` columns).

columns.name: revision_id
columns.notes: primary key of the revision chain

notes: Full snapshot of a work order and its children per revision; `is_last_revision` marks the chain end.
`data_*` columns hold serialised copies of the child tables.

tables.name: wo_soparts
tables.purpose: Special-order / non-stock part lines on a work order.

columns.name: qty
columns.notes: values <= -99999 are treated as deleted

tables.name: wo_tax
tables.purpose: Province/tax selection and computed tax for a work order (working copy).

tables.name: calcquote_hours
tables.purpose: Calculator staging: labour lines while a quote is being priced.

tables.name: customer_qo_packing_slip
tables.purpose: Packing slip header generated from a customer quote.

tables.name: customer_quote
tables.purpose: Customer quote header (status, payment terms, ship-to, tax, revision chain).
notes: Quote header; `workordernumber` reuses the work-order number rather than having its own sequence.

tables.name: quote_parts_incurred
tables.purpose: Incurred-cost counterpart of `quote_parts` (cost basis for margin).

tables.name: standalone_quote
tables.purpose: Standalone (no work order) quote header; supports revisions and soft delete.
notes: No work order behind it; supports soft delete (`is_deleted`) and revision chains.

tables.name: purchaseorder
tables.purpose: Purchase order header (supplier, status, approval, shipment type, transfer metadata).

columns.name: purchase_order_number
columns.notes: legacy display value; PO number concept removed 2025-07-07

columns.name: shipment_type
columns.notes: enum: alliance, cls, alliancepickup, clspickup, contractor, customer, subcontractor, clscustomer, alliancemaintenance, ''

columns.name: is_approved
columns.notes: approval gate; reset to 0 on edit

notes: `purchase_order_number` is legacy: since 2025-07-07 the UI displays `id` instead (functions.php:5948-5957).
`status_on_july_21_2025` and `shipment_type_bkup_18july2025` are frozen pre-migration snapshots kept by staff.
`is_approved` is reset to 0 whenever an approved PO is edited.

tables.name: po_invoice
tables.purpose: Supplier invoice against a PO (tax split GST/PST/HST/TVP, Sage sync flag).

columns.name: sub_total
columns.notes: varchar containing a formatted amount

columns.name: total_amount
columns.notes: varchar containing a formatted amount

notes: `sub_total` and `total_amount` are varchar, stored pre-formatted.
`tax_hst` / `tax_gst` / `tax_pst` / `tax_tvp` are separate components of `tax_amount`.

tables.name: po_invoice_parts
tables.purpose: Supplier invoice parts lines (actual vs backorder qty).
notes: `actual_qty` vs `backorder_qty` record what actually arrived; `price` and `linetotal` are varchar.

tables.name: po_notification
tables.purpose: Per-user "notify me" subscription for a PO or quote.

tables.name: po_parts
tables.purpose: Purchase order parts lines (`qty_received` drives partial-receipt status).
notes: `qty_received` drives the Received / Partial Delivery status; `price` is varchar.

tables.name: po_preorder
tables.purpose: Pre-order header (parts requested before a PO exists).

tables.name: po_quote_suppliers
tables.purpose: Suppliers invited to an RFQ, with per-supplier response status.

tables.name: po_submission_after_approval
tables.purpose: Queued e-mail of an approved PO to the supplier, with attachment options.

tables.name: rga
tables.purpose: Return-goods-authorisation header (return to supplier, warranty or credit).
notes: Supplier return with its own status ladder and revision counter.

tables.name: rga_invoice
tables.purpose: RGA credit/invoice record raised against a supplier return.

tables.name: rga_invoice_parts
tables.purpose: RGA invoice parts lines (defined, zero rows in this snapshot).

tables.name: rga_invoice_soparts
tables.purpose: RGA invoice special-order lines (defined, zero rows).

tables.name: rga_parts
tables.purpose: RGA parts lines (qty, reason, warranty flag, linked PO part).
notes: `po_part_id` links back to the originating `po_parts` row; `price` is varchar.

tables.name: tjx_fixture_parts
tables.purpose: Parts that make up a fixture, with per-part markup and ratio per fixture.
notes: `markup` and `part_ratio_perfixture` are the TJX pricing layer.

tables.name: tjx_fixture_parts_per_quote
tables.purpose: Fixture parts instantiated on a quote.

tables.name: tjx_prices_per_quote
tables.purpose: Per-quote price overrides for TJX parts.

tables.name: tjx_quote
tables.purpose: TJX fixture quote header. Carries totals twice: with markup and `withoutmarkup_*`.

columns.name: withoutmarkup_total_amount
columns.notes: cost-side total; must reconcile with total_amount through the recorded markup

notes: Two complete totals per quote: with markup (`subtotal_amount`/`tax_amount`/`total_amount`) and without (`withoutmarkup_*`).
Revisions chain through `revision_no`; `tjx_quote_revisions` snapshots the detail.

tables.name: tjx_quote_downloads
tables.purpose: Generated TJX quote PDF download records.

tables.name: tjx_quote_extra_workorders
tables.purpose: Additional work orders attached to a TJX quote.

tables.name: tjx_quote_fixtures
tables.purpose: Fixtures selected per room on a TJX quote.

tables.name: tjx_quote_lastused_sharedpart
tables.purpose: Last-used shared part per TJX quote (UI helper).

tables.name: tjx_quote_revisions
tables.purpose: Full revision snapshot of a TJX quote (quote/fixtures/parts/soparts).

tables.name: tjx_sub_invoice
tables.purpose: TJX subcontractor invoice header (checklist flags, rejected count).
notes: Gated by `chk_project_reading`, `chk_project_photos`, `chk_project_signoff`; `rejected_count` counts rejections.

tables.name: tjx_sub_invoice_fixtures
tables.purpose: Fixtures on a TJX subcontractor invoice.

tables.name: tjx_wo_soparts
tables.purpose: Special-order parts on TJX-generated work orders.

tables.name: material_checklist_defective_parts
tables.purpose: Defective parts recorded on a checklist.

tables.name: material_warranty
tables.purpose: Material warranty per part/WO/site with expiration date.
notes: Deleted and re-created whenever an invoice is recalculated (calc_submit.php).

tables.name: site_activity_logs
tables.purpose: Global activity log: row id + table + action + user + php file.
notes: The only audit trail: one row per write, with the calling PHP file.

tables.name: site_address_change_log
tables.purpose: Audit of site address changes detected by cron.

tables.name: subcontractor_additional_documents
tables.purpose: Other compliance documents attached to a subcontractor.

tables.name: subcontractor_wsib_insurance_documents
tables.purpose: WSIB / insurance certificate documents with expiry and reminder state.
notes: Expiry drives the WSIB gate on work-order assignment; blanket bypass is `users.user_addworkorder_without_wsib`.

tables.name: messages
notes: Internal portal inbox; `read` is a smallint flag, `datetime` is a varchar.

tables.name: messages_links
tables.purpose: E-mailed confirmation links tied to a WO (key, responded flag).

tables.name: sub_stock_messages
tables.purpose: Stock messages shown to subcontractors in their portal.

tables.name: api_sc_webhook
tables.purpose: Inbound ServiceChannel webhook payloads and derived statuses.

tables.name: rejected_invoices
tables.purpose: Invoices rejected by a customer (reason, content, who rejected).

tables.name: rejected_quotes
tables.purpose: Quotes rejected by a customer (reason, content, who rejected).

tables.name: signoff_cron
tables.purpose: Work queue for extracting technician sign-off sheets from uploaded PDFs.

tables.name: undispatched_batch_upload
tables.purpose: Batch-upload staging for undispatched work orders.

tables.name: undispatched_workorders
tables.purpose: Imported-but-not-yet-created work orders from the dispatch feed.

tables.name: user_permissions
notes: Named per-user grants; rows were in the lost InnoDB pages of this archive.

tables.name: user_permissions_price_management
tables.purpose: Grant table for the parts price editor (rows unrecoverable).

format.column.key: PK | UNIQUE | INDEX | absent (no index covers the column)
format.column.type: MySQL 5.7 column_type exactly as stored, e.g. "varchar(30)", "enum(...)", "int(11)"
format.table.engine: MyISAM or InnoDB, as in the legacy schema
format.table.row_count_observed: rows visible in the recovered snapshot (0 for InnoDB: definitions only)
format.keys: reconstructed from information_schema.statistics; columns in seq_in_index order
